entities.name: Death Speakers
entities.description: Occult-practicing Aysen group evidencing a schism in Aysen culture on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: City on Ulgrotha where the schism unfolded.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Ended attacks on Aysen, noticed the schism and supplied black magic books.

entities.name: Serra inquisitors
entities.description: Conducted armed raids on Death Speakers' homes.

entities.name: Samite
entities.description: Tried to avoid involvement; some harbored Death Speakers.

entities.name: Grandmother Sengir
entities.description: Source of the black magic books.

events.summary: Baron Sengir stopped his constant attacks on Aysen, and citizens turned on the Death Speakers.
events.quote: After Baron Sengir stopped his constant attacks against Aysen, the citizenship started to turn on the Death Speakers.

events.summary: The Serra inquisitors began armed raids on Death Speakers' homes.
events.quote: The Serra inquisitors started to conduct armed raids on the homes of Death Speakers

events.summary: The Baron supplied black magic books from Grandmother Sengir to turn youths into puppets.
events.quote: provided a variety of books of black magic from Grandmother Sengir to some of the Death Speakers

relations.quote: to turn the more impressionable youth into his puppets
